<description>
Deprecated in v32 (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35605), this deletes the useless and harmful `removeprunedfunds` RPC.

It also removes deleting of watchonly transactions from the not-watchonly migrated wallet, which in theory we should clean up, but in practice this does nothing for the user, the only observable change is that if the user knows the txid they can do `gettransaction` and the migrated wallet will return the transaction information even though it does not have keys for the transaction, AFAICT for both GUI and RPC having irrelevant transactions inside of wallet is harmless and does not affect the output of anything, since most stuff is gated behind `IsMine()` anyways.

Removing both the RPC and the deletion of watchonly tx'es allows deleting the logic for transaction removal and the associated tests.

_LLM Disclosure: Not used to write this PR or PR description, but I recently replaced clang on my machine with gemma-4-26B directly generating machine code._
</description>

<commits>
a5796bc478 wallet: rpc: Delete removeprunedfunds

21102a46be wallet: migration: don't prune unnecessary tx'es from DB

While this is nice in theory, it accomplishes very little in practice
for the user, and deleting this allows removal of all transaction
deleting logic.

df1f84d459 wallet: qa: Prune unused functions for tx removal

There is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete
these functions.

34f9514634 doc: release note for removeprunedfunds rpc deletion
